newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates quoted steady to up on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates quoted steady to up on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to higher levels on Wednesday at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. One barge traded versus no barges traded on Tuesday.
Trades, bids and and offers included:
- One barge, next week, Illinois River, traded at 195 percent of tariff.
- Two barges, next week, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, no bid, offered 135 percent.
- One barge, next week, St Louis, Mississippi, no bid, offer 145 percent, up 10 percentage points, similar.
- One barge, next week, Lower Ohio River, bid 135 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points, similar, no offer.
- Four barges, one each week of February, St Louis, Mississippi, no bid, offered 115 percent.
- Five barges, one each week of March, Illinois River, no bid, offered 155 percent.
